name: Meikuru! Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!
original_name: めいくるッ！ Welcome to Happy Maid Life!!
source:
The protagonist is an ordinary student, enjoying his school life with his friends and classmates. One day, his homeroom teacher tells them, "We are having a training student from Japan Maid Academy." Maid? Academy? They don't know what's going on. On the next day, the maid comes to his school, and they panicked. This is a slapstick school maid adventure game.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
主人公是一名普通学生，与朋友和同学一起享受校园生活。一天，班主任告诉大家：“日本女仆学院将派来一名实习生。”女仆？学院？所有人都不明白是怎么回事。第二天，女仆来到学校，众人顿时陷入混乱。这是一部喧闹欢乐的校园女仆冒险游戏。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
